semiconductor_relevance: High — Nova Ltd. is a key provider of metrology solutions essential for advanced process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nova Ltd. specializes in high-performance metrology solutions that enhance the precision and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their innovative products support various applications, including Logic, Memory, Advanced Packaging, and Specialty Devices, enabling manufacturers to improve yields and accelerate time to market.
capabilities: Optical metrology solutions for advanced packaging
High-precision measurement systems for semiconductor fabrication
Modular metrology platforms adaptable to various wafer sizes

regional_presence.Israel: Nova develops its solutions through R&D centers located in Israel.
